lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform, though widths vary from fine line segments to broader bands.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The third and eleventh stripes from the anterior terminate at approximately 60% of the torso height; the posterior-most stripe is abbreviated to a short segment.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower posterior haunch align horizontally relative to the ventral line.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white patch on the lower throat/neck region; two distinct white spots on the muzzle; high-contrast white fur on the underside of the tail.
